title: THE VILLAGE THAT COULD NOT SLEEP
author: GPT

rounds.summary: Intimate counterweight after S1's scale: a six-hour weather window, fourteen patients, and a reasoning chain (what do they share besides ancestry; resin vapor suppressing anesthetic clearance; a twelve-minute blood-gas discriminating test) that is falsifiable at the bedside and surprising beforehand, clear afterwards. Consent is built into the plot (patients or proxies, physician, anesthetists, flight crew can all refuse), and the villagers' own household knowledge of the resin is the missing variable, so intelligence is shared rather than monopolized.

Selected concept preserved (C05, selected as S2 in B01). Representations weighed: toxicology lecture; genetic search; exposure gradient read from the order of reactions. Adopted the third and attacked its load-bearing assumption (that the hearth explains everything) by building a pre-registered prediction that misses once, so the miss exposes the clinic's own stove as the source. Critic duty from B01 honoured: the key moves are shared with Marta Vell (the dark-cake knowledge), Dr. Hale (the block technique and consent line), Dr. Rusk (the clinic and the stove), and Captain Brandt (the lift). Outcome: ten patients blocked and four under general with no fever, two flown out on the first lift, a written provisional protocol; costs: forty cakes of the village's winter heat, dark cake banned indoors, two long recoveries away from home, an unchecked threshold.

What improves: all fourteen patients get surgery or stabilisation through the night, two are flown out on the first lift, none fevers, and a written provisional protocol exists. For whom: the fourteen patients first, then Nemea's clinic and the kilns. Decisive contributions of Illuminara: reads the order of the reactions as an exposure gradient, writes a falsifiable ranking before the test, accepts the miss and traces it to the clinic's own stove, and proposes the fuel swap and the machine-ordered sequence. Credible remaining cost: forty cakes of pale resin (the village's winter heat), dark cake banned indoors with idle kilns, two long recoveries away from home, and an unchecked threshold. Rule 3a is met; P2 asks that the other parties' contributions be sturdier, not that the result change.

Preserved Claude's attributed fallback draft, voice, five-scene concept, pre-written ranking, honest miss, Marta's decisive knowledge and winter-price condition, Hale's consent line, Rusk's veto, Brandt's flight and the signed provisional protocol. Revised only the three ranked T02 points and their arithmetic consequences. Illuminara remains the decisive pattern-reader and falsifier while Marta, Rusk, Hale and Brandt each contribute an indispensable action or boundary.

What improves: all fourteen patients are treated or flown, none fevers after the swap, and a signed provisional bench protocol exists. For whom: the fourteen patients first, then Nemea's clinic and kilns. Decisive contributions of Illuminara: reads the order of reactions as an exposure gradient, writes a falsifiable ranking before the test, accepts the Ines miss and follows it to the clinic's own stove, designs the staged two-grate swap with measurement, and hands Hale a protocol he can use. Credible remaining cost: forty cakes of pale resin, idle kilns, two long recoveries away from home, an unchecked threshold. Rule 3a is met and T03 states the cost honestly.

Preserved the ink-signed ranking, the honest Ines miss, Marta's dark-cake knowledge and winter-price condition, Rusk's independent stop authority, Hale's consent line, Ilo's mother, Brandt's unneeded second lift, and the plain-hand protocol. The T05 changes are limited to Claude T04's three ranked points and their direct continuity consequences. Illuminara remains the decisive pattern-reader and falsifier while Marta, Rusk, Hale and Brandt retain indispensable actions and vetoes.

What improves: twelve of the fourteen are treated here without a further fever, two are flown, and a signed provisional bench protocol exists. For whom: the fourteen patients first, then Nemea's clinic and kilns. Decisive contributions of Illuminara: reads the order of reactions as an exposure gradient, writes a falsifiable ranking before the test, accepts the Ines miss and follows it to the clinic's own stove, designs the staged two-grate swap with measurement, and hands Hale a protocol he can use. Credible remaining cost: forty cakes of pale resin, idle kilns, two long recoveries away from home, an unchecked threshold. Rule 3a is met for twelve patients on the page; for the two flown patients the positive result is asserted but not secured (see P1).

A village's own winter fuel turns out to be the anaesthetic's hidden accomplice, and a ranking written in ink before the test, wrong once and honest about it, lets four people with four vetoes change the fire without losing the wounded.
